# stalwart_mta_stage_data (Data Source)

Configures message processing rules for the SMTP DATA stage. This singleton object always exists: creating the resource adopts the current server settings and destroying it only removes the resource from state.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `add_auth_results_header` (Attributes) Whether to add an Authentication-Results header to the message (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--add_auth_results_header))
- `add_date_header` (Attributes) Whether to add a Date header to the message (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--add_date_header))
- `add_delivered_to_header` (Boolean) Whether to add a Delivered-To header to the message
- `add_message_id_header` (Attributes) Whether to add a Message-Id header to the message (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--add_message_id_header))
- `add_received_header` (Attributes) Whether to add a Received header to the message (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--add_received_header))
- `add_received_spf_header` (Attributes) Whether to add a Received-SPF header to the message (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--add_received_spf_header))
- `add_return_path_header` (Attributes) Whether to add a Return-Path header to the message (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--add_return_path_header))
- `enable_spam_filter` (Attributes) Whether to enable the spam filter for incoming messages (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--enable_spam_filter))
- `id` (String) Always `singleton`.
- `max_message_size` (Attributes) Maximum size of a message in bytes (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--max_message_size))
- `max_messages` (Attributes) Maximum number of messages that can be submitted per SMTP session (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--max_messages))
- `max_received_headers` (Attributes) Maximum limit on the number of Received headers, which helps to prevent message loops (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--max_received_headers))
- `script` (Attributes) Which Sieve script to run after the client sends a DATA command (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--script))
